of.needed: whether the environment uses OperatorHub as the installation/upgrade method for cert-manager

consequence.statement: Operators using OperatorHub to install or upgrade cert-manager cannot proceed with v1.17.0 or later; they must migrate to alternative installation methods such as Helm charts or direct manifest deployment.
consequence.remediation: Switch to Helm-based installation, direct kubectl manifests, or other supported installation methods. See cert-manager installation documentation for alternatives to OperatorHub.

assertion.statement: OperatorHub packages for cert-manager are no longer published; v1.16.5 is the last release available on OperatorHub, and v1.17.0+ cannot be installed via that distribution channel.

checks.detail: no compatibility row for operatorhub in either release
